subject: PO format & invoice splits / net45 + prepay discount?
messages:
From: Jason Lee <procurement@starlithealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@starlithealth.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO template + invoice cadence question

Hi Mateo,

We're preparing to issue a blanket PO for Redwood for our multi-department rollout. A couple of procurement constraints came up and want to confirm Redwood can comply before we route the PO:

- We require a PO header with fields: PO Number, Company Entity (Starlit Health Inc. - AP Entity ID), BU Code, Project ID. Can you ensure those fields map to your invoice header?
- Our finance team prefers split invoicing: one invoice per project milestone (we estimate 2-4 invoices across the year). Is Redwood able to accept multiple invoices against a single PO?
- Standard Starlit terms are net45. Any concerns?
- If we prepay annual commitment up front, what discount can Redwood offer? We may be able to commit to a 12-month, 200k ARR spend.

I've attached our PO template for your billing team. If you can point to any special requirements (tax ids, remittance instructions, invoicing email) we'll include them in the PO to speed AP setup.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — procurement would like this by Monday to avoid a delay.

Thanks,
Jason Lee
Procurement Manager
Starlit Health
[Attachment: Starlit_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <procurement@starlithealth.com>
Cc: billing@starlithealth.com, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO template + invoice cadence question

Hi Jason — thanks for the PO template and the clear list. Short answers first: yes on the PO header fields, yes we can invoice multiple times against one PO (with limits), and net45 is acceptable pending standard credit checks. On prepay discount: we can offer an annual prepayment discount; I outline options below.

Details / ask from our side so we can finalize:
- Invoice header: we require PO Number and Company Entity to match line items on the invoice. Please ensure the PO includes the Project ID as an invoice line reference.
- Invoice cadence: we can accept up to 3 invoices against a single PO without an administrative fee. For more than 3 invoices per PO we do apply a $200 per-invoice processing fee (covers reconciliation and additional accounting labor). If you truly need 4+ splits we can waive the fee with a minimal contract amendment.
- Net terms: net45 is fine. We will need a signed SOW/Order Form and your AP contact for electronic invoicing. For net45 on new accounts we run a standard credit validation (brief, <3 business days).
- Prepay discount: options we can offer for a 12-month commitment at ~$200k ARR: 7% off for annual prepay (Finance-approved), 9% off for ACH + signed amendment + payment within 5 business days (requires Director approval).

I'll put this into a short amendment/quote and send over a redlined doc. Could you confirm: 1) Acceptable invoice email (AP remittance) and 2) whether the PO will include BU Code and Project ID on every line?

Thanks — I looped in Grace from Finance for the netterm/discount confirmation.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0187
[Attachment: Redwood_ProForma_Quote_STL-4521.pdf (pdf)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: finance-ops@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: PO template + invoice cadence question — Finance checks

Mateo / Ben — forwarding Starlit's request. Quick finance guidance:

- Net45: acceptable. We require customer W-9 or equivalent tax documentation (for US entities) and confirmed AP remittance email.
- Invoicing rules: we can accept up to 3 invoices per PO without fee. If customer requests >3, propose $200 processing fee per extra invoice. Exception: if they prepay annual commitment we can waive fees and allow up to 4 splits.
- Discounts: I can approve up to 7% for prepay without further escalation. 8-9% would need Director-level sign-off (finance director).
- PO matching: finance will only pay invoices where PO # and Company Entity fields exactly match. Project ID should be present on the invoice line-level or a reference field; otherwise it will fail three-way match rules in our ERP.

Action for sales: propose 7% annual prepay discount and accept up to 3 invoices per PO. If customer requests 4 splits and 8%+, route to Hannah (Finance Director).

Grace O'Connor
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <procurement@starlithealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO template + invoice cadence question — proposal

Hi Jason — thanks for the template and the quick turnaround. Based on internal review here's our proposal to keep the PO routing moving:

1) Invoice header & PO mapping
- Redwood will honor PO header fields: PO Number, Company Entity, BU Code, Project ID. Project ID must appear on the invoice line as a reference or in the invoice's "PO Line Ref" field to satisfy our reconciliation.

2) Invoice splits and fees
- We will accept up to 3 invoices per PO with no admin fee. If you need 4 invoices, we can accept that if the customer signs the attached short amendment (waives the $200 processing fee).

3) Net terms
- Net45 accepted. Redwood requires signed Order Form + W-9 (or tax documentation) prior to the first invoice. Credit validation typically completes within 3 business days.

4) Prepay discount
- We can offer 7% off for a 12-month annual prepayment for the committed spend level you mentioned (~$200k ARR). If you can do ACH + payment within 5 business days and sign the amendment we can route for Director approval for up to 9% — please let me know if you'd like us to pursue that.

Next steps:
- If acceptable, please reply with AP remittance email and confirm the PO will include Project ID on invoices.
- I'll attach the amendment and a DocuSign link for the 7% prepay option.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Amendment-annual-prepay.docx (docx)]
